title: 3. Votes on any subject type (L)
description:
Shipped story: ship-15b04c (voting on any subject). Size L.

As a signed-in reader, I want to vote on any subject, so that readers steer the map.

Acceptance criteria:
- Subject types: items, submissions, stories, proposals, concepts.
- Downvotes are supported, plus flags: wrong, belongs-under, better-name, each requiring a reason.
- Any signed-in reader can vote; there is no karma gate.
- Votes are keyed by the pairwise siteSubject, never by the Person ID.
- The adopted shrinkage and new-account weighting are kept unchanged (existing scoring specs stay green).
- Votes on a subject type that does not exist, or by a signed-out reader, are rejected.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
